programme.title: 法網狙擊:14
programme.desc: 律師甘祖贊（謝天華飾）與刑事檢控官況天藍（楊怡飾）本是同居情侶，但一次求婚不遂令兩人分手收場，不過命運弄人，祖贊剛轉職成為刑事檢控官，再度與天藍共處，但二人辦案手法截然不同，加上新秘書祝雙悅（王君馨飾）的介入，令惡劣的關係到了無可挽救的地步，但祖贊為拒婚一事一直耿耿於懷，孰知天藍真的另有隱情

programme.title: 好日子:20
programme.desc: 湯家村村委會主任湯志成的兒子從美國歸來，帶回土地使用的新理念湯家村的經濟想要更上一層樓，需與鄰村經濟基礎較差有不少閒置土地的于家堡村合作，雙方均會受益比鄰的于家堡村土地產值低並有不少閒置土地于家堡村主任於長福因擔心合作過程中失去自己主任的權利，抵制優厚條件和高利潤分成合作

programme.desc: 律師甘祖贊（謝天華飾）與刑事檢控官況天藍（楊怡飾）本是同居情侶，但一次求婚不遂令兩人分手收場，不過命運弄人，祖贊剛轉職成為刑事檢控官，再度與天藍共處，但二人辦案手法截然不同，加上新秘書祝雙悅（王君馨飾）的介入，令惡劣的關係到了無可挽救的地步，但祖贊為拒婚一事一直耿耿於懷，孰知天藍真的另有隱情

programme.title: 金宵大廈:8
programme.desc: 蕭偉明（陳山聰飾）來到殘舊且品流複雜的金宵大廈當看更，遇上這裡的空姐住客Alex（李施嬅飾）容貌竟與夢中一直纏繞自己的旗袍女子相同！阿蕭接近Alex，瞭解更多彼此的關聯其間金宵大廈怪事不斷，不停上演著其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿蕭更發現Alex竟是一個殘影！

programme.title: 法證先鋒4:15
programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 真情:16
programme.desc: 李標炳（劉丹 飾）和妻子梁潤善（李司棋 飾）結婚多年，靠著經營燒臘店為生，儘管生活不易，但兩人彼此珍惜，為家庭付出，內心充實著幸福和滿足然而，他們的親情觀和家庭觀全並沒有遺傳給下一代，家中的四個兒女需要依靠他們自己的力量走完人生路...

programme.title: 天天天晴:59
programme.desc: 龍福是本地名門石敢當集團旗下的珠寶店，在老闆娘明心安領導下，經歷九七回歸亞洲金融風暴沙士和金融海嘯等大大小小風波，由瀕臨結業至成為數一數二的珠寶店品牌精明的心深受店內員工及同行敬重，令人艷羨雖然風光背後事業和家庭各有隱憂，但樂觀的她積極面對，充滿正能量

programme.desc: 蕭偉明（陳山聰飾）來到殘舊且品流複雜的金宵大廈當看更，遇上這裡的空姐住客Alex（李施嬅飾）容貌竟與夢中一直纏繞自己的旗袍女子相同！阿蕭接近Alex，瞭解更多彼此的關聯其間金宵大廈怪事不斷，不停上演著其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿蕭更發現Alex竟是一個殘影！

programme.title: News金探號

programme.desc: 藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊在欠發達地區進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死後的兩心相許，還來不及坦誠心意，一場事故讓傅雲深陷入人生低谷，他斬斷與朱舊的聯繫一年後，朱舊以家庭醫生的身份與傅雲深重逢，面對他的百般刁難，朱舊用堅韌樂觀的心態與不離不棄的愛慢慢治癒雲深，陪他走出黑暗深淵

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: 我們的翻譯官
programme.desc: 講述了翻譯官林西和語譯天下公司首席技術官肖一成，解開心結，一起追求夢想，互相理解互相成就，最終有情人終成眷屬，實現職業夢想的故事！

programme.title: 城中之城
programme.desc: 聚焦2018年前後金融改革與發展，以兩代金融人的迷茫與奮鬥守正與搏殺的人生抉擇為切入口，全景式地展開金融城內銀行證券信託投行地產商等各色人等的命運沉浮，折射出金融改革與發展大時代的奔湧浪潮！

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The iron triangle comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: Inside the Forbidden City
programme.desc: This film marks the Shaw Brothers quintessential Huangmei Opera costume drama, with a superb performance from Ivy Ling Po and Chin Feng.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: In one of her first roles, Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon villain Cheng Pei Pei plays a kung-fu Nancy Drew who must face a secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: This epic classic charts a romance between two teenage cousins, who pursue their relationship despite objections from their respective families.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperors Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designers creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure features the legendary Alexander Fu Sheng as a young wushu warrior, in a film considered director Chu Yuans best ever.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star Little Lark in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this Martial Arts World saga of a masked master of the Black Sand Hand Technique, starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Director Li Han Hsiang adapts three erotic tales from Chinese classical literature for the silver screen. Starring Tien Lie, Hu Chin and Chen Ping.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: Love With the Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: Pauline Wong plays a pregnant student who marries a sympathetic, yet equally heartbroken, passer-by in Jamie Luks directing debut.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker The Jade Raksha.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owners son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the Yuan Yang Swords, which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: An insane swordsman takes to making Chinese lamps from the skin of his enemies sisters, mistresses and wives!

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer director Yueh Fengs most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: First instalment of the new remake of The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, adapted from Jin Yongs novel, see Zhang Wu Ji embroiled in a dispute involving two legendary weapons.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: After a jewelry store heist, the young thieves left behind a graffiti tag that reads FRANK, sparking public curiosity about their motives. What message are they trying to convey?

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: After two cult classic films from the 90s - director Herman Yau Anthony Wong reunite, and together with Gordon Lam, Michelle Wai Jojo Goh, challenge your limit in this paranormal thriller.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: Inspector Yans daughter is found dead, and her classmate Wen is arrested. However, when another killing occurs after Wens imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect that the true killer is still at large.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhens life takes a downturn after giving birth. Exhausted by childcare, ignored by her husband and burdened by in-laws and work, she endures lonely nights. Will dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Ah Long lives in hardship with his daughter. When she is abducted in Thailand, Longs faith shatters, and he risks everything to track down the trafficking ring, transforming into a vengeful killer.

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well 2009
programme.desc: Yu Chu is brilliant but impossible to date. Her brother hires love expert Dick to woo her and break a curse but Yu Chu falls for him fast and wont let Dick go without a fight.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: A veteran and a passionate street dancer both strive to reach their goals and pursue their dreams in street dancing. After overcoming many challenges, can they finally shine on stage?

programme.title: Call Of Heroes
programme.desc: Sean Lau, Louise Koo Eddie Peng star in this action-packed story of a group of villagers who stand up to a cruel young warlord to protect their home.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Aaron Kwok plays the Monkey King alongside Gong Lis White Bone Spirit in this powerful sequel to the 2014 box office hit.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: An imperial guard and his three traitorous friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later, they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB with a detective novelist, a drifter and a pianist. When the owner and receptionist turn up dead, every guest becomes both suspect and sleuth...

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: As a juror in a high-profile case learns that his daughter has been mysteriously kidnapped, he must decide whether to use his special skills to influence the trial as demanded by the kidnappers.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica falls for an online dating app scam with young Joe, who poses as a French engineer. What begins as a romance built on lies ultimately transforms two seemingly mismatched souls.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman takes charge of an operation to arrest the criminals who perform a heist on the train, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead...

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: In this screen adaptation of Louis Chas famous novel, Stephen Chow plays small time punk Wei Xiao Bao alongside an all-star cast.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: An archaeologist uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream, so he leads his team to a fantastical adventure into the glacier to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Framed and forced to leave all he loves, a grocery clerk ultimately grows into one of Shanghais most powerful mob bosses. Yet, can he leave the past behind?

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the sick people of Asia and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Lis new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1977
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the Little Lark in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the directors previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killers claims of an evil spell, then it doesnt let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the others mole.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a Phantom Bullet that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his fathers land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wongs marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wongs close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a super pill invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. Bs superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Inheritors
programme.desc: Inheritors is a multi-media product from CGTN that shines a light on Chinas rich Intangible Cultural Heritage. Each 30-minute TV edition is hosted by a long-term expatriate in China who has a unique understanding of the countrys culture. He or she will introduce viewers to people who are dedicating their lives to its protection, inheritance, innovation, development and promotion.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Travelogue
programme.desc: Travelogue is a 30-minute travel program. Through the journeys of our intrepid hosts, we experience the beauty, culture and mystery of China, discovering how people live in this vast country and showcasing Chinas transformation to the world.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. programme.title: Wide World of Fights Victor Ortiz vs. Vivian Harris
programme.desc: Wide World Of Fights includes all styles of fighting from around the world in one show! This episode features a middleweight brawl between top contenders Victor Ortiz and Vivian Harris, as well as kickboxing, sumo, arm wrestling and more!

programme.title: Judo for the World - Tokyo Grand Slam
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Tokyo Grand Slam where the home nation is looking to dominate as they fielded 7 of Japans 8 world champions. Plus we catch up with Japans brother and sister superstars, the Abes.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Jhonny Gonzalez vs Gerry Penalosa
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Jhonny Gonzalez defending the WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa. A left hook to the body ends the fight. Also on the card, a controversial ending to the Nate Campbell Ali Funeka brawl.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法 Exploration Method of Love

programme.title: 大地餐桌 第二季 Earthly Ambrosia S2

programme.title: 正义女神 Themis

programme.title: 百味人生 Bittersweet Destiny

programme.title: 型男大主厨 Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的.

programme.title: 百味人生 Bittersweet Destiny

programme.title: 正义女神 Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. BIG Star Entertainment Awards- Most Entertaining Film Debut Male- Arjun Kapoor.

programme.title: Apurva
programme.desc: In a thrilling twist, Apurva, a clever and brave woman, outsmarts the notorious Chambal gang, proving that intelligence and wit can triumph over even the most feared criminals. Release Year: 2023 Director: Nikhil Nagesh Bhat Awards: 4 nominations.

programme.title: Jamai Raja
programme.desc: When the wealthy Durgeshwaris daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her. Release Year: 1990 Director: A. Kodandarami Reddy.

programme.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
programme.desc: A man and a woman, engaged to marry different people, spend a couple of hours chatting together at a train station only to fall for each other. Release Year: 2007 Director: Shaad Ali.

programme.title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon
programme.desc: A man, who goes by three names, marries three women who all live in the same apartment but are unaware that they have the same husband. Release Year: 2015 Director: Abbas Alibhai Burmawalla, Mastan Alibhai Burmawalla Awards: 2016 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award - Surprise hit film of the year.

programme.title: Kaabil
programme.desc: This is the story of a blind couple who lived, laughed and loved just like everyone in this world. Until one day, a terrible tragedy struck. Release Year: 2017 Director: Sanjay Gupta.

programme.title: Mona Darling
programme.desc: College students investigate deaths occurring immediately after accepting a friend request on social media from Mona, who has gone missing. Release Year: 2017 Director: Shashi Sudigala.

programme.title: Main Aur Charles
programme.desc: Story inspired by true events and told from the perspective of Indian cop Amod Kanth who handled the notorious case of serial killer, Charles Sobhraj. Release Year: 2015 Director: Prawaal Raman.

programme.title: Zaalim

programme.title: Dhanak
programme.desc: Pari takes her blind brother to SRKs shoot inspired by his eye donation poster. Release Year: 2015 Director: Nagesh Kukunoor Awards: 2015 Winner Crystal Bear - Special Mention Generation Kplus - Best Film Nagesh Kukunoor.

programme.title: Hulla
programme.desc: Raj and his wife expect peace in the their new flat. But thanks to the watchmans whistle Raj becomes sleep-deprived. Release Year: 2008 Director: Jaideep Varma.

programme.title: Total Dhamaal
programme.desc: Six people encounter wild jungle animals and danger at every turn while racing against time to find a hidden stash of 500 million rupees. Release Year: 2019 Director: Indra Kumar Awards: 2020 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award -The 100 Crore Club.

programme.desc: 新任女法医程芷昕陈晓华饰从小受林琛韦家雄饰启发，立志加入法医科，入职后却被上司林琛投闲置散林琛与身为重案组高级督察的前妻高淑娴王绮琴饰水火不容，两人因女儿林雪蕾离家出走而再次交集芷昕凭借认真的工作态度赢得林琛认同，并与警员高俊马贯东饰结缘，三人渐成默契十足的办案铁三角芷昕闺密单佩嘉吴若希饰经历失恋失业打击后转任港闻记者，跟资深记者詹柏宇阮浩棕饰从欢喜冤家发展成互相扶持的伙伴正当芷昕事业步入正轨，却闻好友佩嘉死讯，誓要还原真相，为逝者发声！.

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第十五集n胡洁家头发与阮明宇吻合，但他供称只是为查明无名画秘密而持备用钥匙入屋，核查后并未说谎他透露十四年前曾拍到胡洁向湖中丢弃疑似凶器的钢笔，且胡洁所爱之人其实倾心樊降雪此人竟是齐思哲师兄陈楚川；同时老宋遗留药物也装在其诊所药袋陈楚川数日未现身，警方认定他涉两桩命案，全面部署抓捕.

programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 剥茧 今日知多D The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: 第十五集n胡洁家头发与阮明宇吻合，但他供称只是为查明无名画秘密而持备用钥匙入屋，核查后并未说谎他透露十四年前曾拍到胡洁向湖中丢弃疑似凶器的钢笔，且胡洁所爱之人其实倾心樊降雪此人竟是齐思哲师兄陈楚川；同时老宋遗留药物也装在其诊所药袋陈楚川数日未现身，警方认定他涉两桩命案，全面部署抓捕.

programme.title: 蓝朋友．旅朋友 温哥华篇 Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: 王祖蓝一条麻甩到东莞汕头之后，延续系列的真实风格再拍摄旅游节目不过，这趟旅途上会多了一些朋友同行，主轴更是要沿着祖蓝生命中的里程坐标，开展连场深度回访，发掘市井生活中的趣味与温情这次取景版图横跨福州广西温哥华，三个极具特色的地方，都在祖蓝不同的人生阶段留下了重大意义祖蓝分别与三组旅朋友走过街巷，从故乡情缘到文化启蒙，再往最重要的爱情归宿，以旅程片段诉说属于王祖蓝独一无二的故事.

programme.title: 粤讲粤鬼IV Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: 语鬼传神，博大精深，香港不少俗话亦源自广东省各地nn鬼大使麦美恩遂将探索版图扩展至中国，并找来邓智坚戴祖仪许文轩加入鬼导赏团，深入广州等内地城市，发掘相关的有趣典故及出处专业粤语及典故专家亦会现身，追源溯古引经据典，揭示贴地粤语的魅力所在nn此外，喜欢扮鬼扮马的邓智坚还于节目化身单身宅男，透过他追求一众女神的过程，让大家了解多个俗语及术语的含意.

programme.title: 阿爷厨房 The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: 铁汉李家鼎鼎爷武艺非凡毋庸置疑，原来厨艺亦相当耍家！鼎爷设立阿爷厨房，伙拍对美食素有要求的谭玉瑛，每集带大家搜购心水食材，并由鼎爷亲自下厨，炮制多道拿手小菜汤水及甜品，为大家奉上怀旧粤菜好滋味！如何以抵食价煮出正宗古法盐焗鸡的味道？怎样掌控蒸鱼的火候和时间？秋冬时份，不少人爱吃香喷喷煲仔饭，更不会错过香脆的饭焦，但大家又可曾见过有两面饭焦的煲仔饭？且看鼎爷大显身手，一一教路！.

programme.title: 兄弟帮 Big Boys Club
programme.desc: 兄弟帮是由一班好兄弟林盛斌梁竞徽王梓轩范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话流行文化潮流玩意等多元化内容有关爱情两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾谈情说爱，探讨两性相处之道异度空间专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼UFO奇人奇事等刺激话题.

programme.title: 天龙八部 Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: 金庸先生为大家创造了一个波澜壮阔的武侠世界，天龙八部更是金庸小说系列中最受读者喜爱及追捧的巅峰之作之一，它的经典程度不言而喻，也是长盛不衰的改编题材nn故事以北宋哲宗时代为背景，通过丐帮帮主乔峰杨佑宁饰大理世子段誉白澍饰少林小僧虚竹张天阳饰三人的江湖历险与爱恨情仇，以及围绕在他们周围的一众江湖人物，展现了纷繁复杂的武林恩怨和无计可消除的贪嗔痴怨，勾勒了一幅充满人情世态的生活画卷，亦象征大千世界的芸芸众生，皆逃不出情这一字带来的痛苦纠缠.

programme.title: 死有对证 Cause Of Death

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第十六集n陈楚川主动投案，称胡洁当年误以钢笔施救花粉过敏的樊降雪，反刺破其颈部致死；胡洁遇害当晚，齐思哲又能证明他曾在诊所，看似没有作案时间齐思哲重勘后发现胡洁家停水，断定现场是伪造，尸体当时其实藏在诊所洗手间；EDTA残留更证实有人抑制鲁米诺反应警方下令逮捕陈楚川之际，药剂师崔浩因窃取乙醚与西地兰被万国新带走.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 大醬園 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 萬冠園是佛山醬油業百年老字號，大當家萬啟山吳岱融飾與夫人席德容龔慈恩飾堅持傳男不傳女，傳內不傳外的宗旨，可是一宗毒醬油事故，使他不得不答應讓夏小滿朱晨麗飾及葉細么龔嘉欣飾兩女子加入，與其子萬卓楓何廣沛飾成為同期學徒三人與醬園小師傅華歌吳業坤飾建立了複雜的四角關係，又間接揭發了萬家多個秘密，加上卓楓突然被擄走，人心惶惶醬園內，啟山幾個弟弟啟石鄭子誠飾啟川陳嘉輝飾及啟江徐榮飾醞釀分家，醬園外，專員高兆榮袁文傑飾也密謀奪取醬園財產，萬冠園百年基業隨時毀於一旦！.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 食為奴 Gilded Chopsticks
programme.desc: 高天寶王祖藍自小吃盡珍饈百味，各種美食經他一嚐便知龍與鳳，但遭逢家道中落被迫與家僕李衛胡諾言流落街頭，以賣飽糊口，因美食令他結識了賣藝女子紀慕雪萬綺雯京城第一美女年若碧胡定欣少女廚神米小魚何雁詩等人，更因緣際會遇上微服出遊的四皇子胤禛黃智賢，二人氣味相投，被引進到宮內的御膳房當御廚，天寶遇上宿敵蔡鶴亭林盛斌，掀起連場龍爭虎鬥；但天寶萬料不到自己竟捲入由八皇子胤禩張繼聰策動的奪嫡之爭中，在劣勢下天寶成了胤禛的福將，連番替他反敗為勝，但一段意外的婚約卻令天寶由一人之下頓貶為喪家狗.

programme.title: 愛情食物鏈 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 從事食品供應的魯佳芳阮小儀樣子平凡，身材矮小，年過三十仍欠缺戀愛經驗，因一次苦瓜事件，幫助餐飲業才俊劉柏業陳智燊渡過難關，令這位高富帥欣賞到佳芳的內在美，並與她漸生情愫，佳芳的鄰居兼好友高貴芬高海寧對此無法釋懷，賣魚出身的貴芬樣貌身材皆屬女神級數，千方百計也未能令柏業過電，卻召來台灣擔仔麵繼承者洪鱻金剛的青睞，洪鱻為親近貴芬不惜自貶身價與佳芳她們同住劏房，貴芬得不到柏業唯有轉戰二叔劉利高鄭子誠，但後來柏業承受不了外界對女友佳芳的負評，二人關係亮起紅燈；當愛情再不是飲水飽，美醜優劣再無標準，男女同時成了獵人與獵物，血肉橫飛的戀愛激戰即將一發不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O記幹探許浚森陳展鵬飾沈韋力黃智賢飾奉命調查跨國罪案期間，得悉殺虎案幕後黑手魏子樂張頴康飾落網前，曾將神秘訊息發送至暗網，並匯出巨額加密貨幣不久有神秘人策動恐襲，浚森與韋力縱於天才教授唐冠峰方力申飾協助下破案，卻驚覺子樂背後藏着更大陰謀！他們要竭力阻止子樂的同時，也遇到龍頭棍風暴空屋藏白骨重犯越獄等奇案，能否一一掃除險阻？工作上面對的危機升級，感情亦遇挑戰，浚森望跟前女友馬穎思林夏薇飾復合，但困難重重令二人關係出現變數.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.desc: 來自英國的保鏢主管夏天行楊明，到港後奉命保護網絡教主張非凡王浩信，順道尋覓身世線索非凡行事張狂，還藉舉辦拳賽掩護竊密黑客赴港，期間屢遇險境麻煩，幸得天行一一化解事件引來火爆刑警何鐵男伍允龍關注，決心全力追查原來鐵男曾因一時衝動犯下不可告人的過失，性格亦漸走偏鋒拳賽同時激發三人的好戰天性，他們又逐漸發現彼此擁有相同的感應能力，藉以互助互救而三人背後的隱密連繫，更牽涉逾二十年前的金融風暴之戰.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Khabar berita tentang Iskandar dan Aisyah bercuti bersama sampai ke pengetahuan Tengku Maria. Kepulangan Iskandar dan Aisyah ke kondo mengejutkan mereka dengan keberadaan Tengku Maria di dalam kondo itu, Iskandar tergamam melihat Tengku Maria . Iskandar mencari alasan dia terpaksa bawa Aisyah ke kondo itu sementara menanti Haziq. Sangka Iskandar Tengku Maria mahu menerima alasan itu, namun dia tidak menyangka Tengku Maria telah datang semula ke kondo miliknya dan bertemu dengan Aisyah. Tengku Maria telah menghalau Aisyah dari kondo itu dan menuduh Aisyah adalah perempuan simpanan Iskandar. Aisyah cuba merayu tetapi dia tidak mampu lagi, hujan dan petir yang kuat tidak melembutkan hati Tengku Mummy untuk memaafkan Aisyah. Iskandar yang kepenatan tidak menyedari akan apa yang sedang terjadi. Iskandar mencari kehilangan Aisyah pada esok hari.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya berasa rimas apbila meneriman panggilan dari Syarfan berpuluh kali sehari. Dia percaya bahwa Syarfan ada menyembunyikan sesuatu darinya. Dia meluahkan rasa hatinya kepada Najwan yang telah menjadi bodyguard adik iparnya,Syafinaz . Syafinaz mula berasa sayang kepada Najwan. Antasya menemui gambr-gambar Syarfan bersama seorang perempuan dalam bilik stor dan yakin bahawa perempuan tersebut mempunya jawapan kepada persoalannya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Alawiyah menjelaskan pada Jazlan yang beliau telahpun ditunangkan dengan Qasih. Di masjid, setelah tamat kuliah agama, Qasih dengan sengaja bersenda dan beramah mesra dengan bakal Mak Mertuanya Alawiyah dengan tujuan untuk menyakitkan hati Aisyah dan Fatimah sehingga menyebabkan ibu mereka Hapsah begitu marah lalu terus menasihatkan anaknya untuk jaga maruah dan melupakan Jazlan. Pada suatu hari Qasih hampir melanggar kereta seorang pemuda dan di waktu petangnya Qasih menerima sejambak bunga dari pemuda berkenaan. Jazlee pula menghadiahkan strawberry coklat kepada Fatimah

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Luka lama mula terubat apabila Laila menemui ketenangan di tempat yang tidak disangka-sangka, sementara satu pertemuan semula membongkar kebenaran yang selama ini tersembunyi. Ada yang memilih untuk meninggalkan masa lalu, namun ada yang masih bergelut menerima kehilangan.

programme.desc: Alawiyah dan Khatijah berasa resah geliash, tidak lena tidur memikirkan tentang kedua-dua anak mereka. programme.desc: Aisyah hilang arah, dia tidak tahu kemana dia harus pergi. Keadaan Aisyah yang di halau sehelai sepinggan menyebabkan Aisyah kelaparan dan kepenatan. Aisyah singgah di perhentian bus dan bermalam di situ. Angin yang kuat pada malam itu memaksa Aisyah mencari tempat yang tertutup untuk berteduh. Iskandar terjaga dari tidurnya, dia merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena yang terjadi pada Aisyah. Iskandar segera keluar dari kondo dan mencari Aisyah.

programme.title: Kopi Pahit
programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah hilang arah, dia tidak tahu kemana dia harus pergi. Keadaan Aisyah yang di halau sehelai sepinggan menyebabkan Aisyah kelaparan dan kepenatan. Aisyah singgah di perhentian bus dan bermalam di situ. Angin yang kuat pada malam itu memaksa Aisyah mencari tempat yang tertutup untuk berteduh. Tubuh lesu, keletihan dan kelaparan membuatkan Aisyah tidak mampu berjalan dengan baik. Seseorang sedang memerhatikan Aisyah, Aisyah berjalan dalam hujan berbumbungkan kotak yang sudah hancur di basahi hujan. Sebuah kereta datang meluru ke arah Aisyah, Aisyah sempat mengelak tetapi malangnya dia tercampak jauh dan menyebabkan dia tidak sedarkan diri. Iskandar terjaga dari tidurnya, dia merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena yang terjadi pada Aisyah. Iskandar segera keluar dari kondo dan mencari Aisyah.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Pertemuan semula yang menyayat hati dengan Sarah memaksa Uwan berdepan dengan satu babak pahit dalam hidupnya. Pada 1988, Jali dan kumpulannya menyerang hendap Laila dan Shafiq, memaksa mereka berjuang untuk menyelamatkan nyawa.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah terkejut apabila Lukman meninggikan suara hanya kerana dia memegang bajumilik arwah Sarah. Meskipun terkejut, namun Farah cuba memahami penderitaan dankecelaruan yang sedang ditanggung suaminya. Di tempat kerja, Farah didekati Anasyang sangat baik dengannya. Berbanding dengan Dahlia yang sering membulinyadi pejabat.

programme.title: Nasi Tangas
programme.desc: Hairi dan Fatin adalah seorang kawan rapat. Mereka berdua bersama-sama membangunkan sebuah kafe yang dibuka bersama-sama. Hubungan mereka adalah seperti sepasang kekasih, tetapi Hairi dan Fatin tidak pernah lebih daripada seorang rakan. Mira juga rakan yang baik untuk Fatin. Mira mengakui bahawa dia jatuh cinta dengan Hairi.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: Munafik 2
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan menakutkan, seorang penyembuh muslim mendapati imannya diuji apabila membatu seorang perempuan yang terkurung didalam pertempuran, tubuh dan jiwa dengan seorang pemimpin yang jahat.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Ganjil
programme.desc: Nabila dan Amry mengetahui bahawa mereka pernah bertemu tiga tahun lalu di dunia nyata. Teruja dengan peluang untuk akhirnya berjumpa semula, mereka merancang pertemuan.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China And America
programme.desc: Berikutan serangan hendap dalam lawatannya ke Amerika, Wong Fei-hung terpisah daripada rakan-rakan pengembaranya dan mengalami kehilangan ingatan.

programme.title: Detik 12 Malam EP16
programme.desc: Saiful Azmi Pengantara Detik 12 Malam dengan dibantu krew produksi melakukan penyiasatan tentang kisah misteri yang berlaku di Bandar Tasek Puteri, Rawang, Selangor. Tasek ini pernah di terokai sebagai pusat perlombongan satu masa lalu. Menurut Haji Fadzil Hanapie dan Shiriman Hakim Razali penduduk asal kawasan tersebut, mereka pernah ternampak mengalami peristiwa menyeramkan dan menakut bertemu dengan lembaga misteri dan sekumpulan lembaga berjubah putih yang dikatakn Bunian. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di lokasi tersebut selepas 12 malam. Pengantara sendiri mengalami kejadian seram apabila terhidu bau wangi bunga rampai dan dapat merasakan kehadiran lembaga misteri sebagai perkampungan Orang Bunian.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

Shakir tidak bersetuju Abil dikurung, namun tidak mampu mengubah keadaan apabila ibunya terpaksa mendapatkan dadah untuk Abil. Apabila Mak Leha merancang menunaikan umrah, abangnya bersetuju menunaikan ibadah itu bagi menggantikan Abil yang semakin teruk keadaannya.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Wo Jiao Zhang Si De
programme.desc: Set during the Chinese Communist Revolution, this historical drama follows the life of Zhang Side, a humble peasant from Sichuan who joined the Red Army. Rather than portraying him as an oversized hero, the series focuses on his quiet work ethic and selflessnessfrom surviving the Long March to serving as a guard in Yanan. In 1944, Zhang tragically dies when a charcoal kiln collapses, sacrificing his life to save a fellow soldier and leaving behind an enduring legacy of selfless service

programme.title: Jue Mi Shi Ming
programme.desc: In the early 1930s, the Communist Party established a top-secret underground route connecting Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shantou, and Fujian to their main base in Ruijin to bypass severe military blockades. Disguised as ordinary shopkeepers, boatmen, and doctors, covert couriers risked their lives to outsmart enemy forces. Together, they smuggled vital intelligence, essential supplies, and safely escorted key leadersincluding Zhou Enlaiacross enemy lines
